title: pinus nigra var. pallasiana
intro: Pinus nigra var. pallasiana, commonly known as Black Pine, is a subspecies of evergreen tree native to the mountainous regions of the Balkans and Turkey. The essential oil extracted from the needles of Black Pine has been traditionally used to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and improve respiratory health, making it a popular natural remedy. The oil's therapeutic actions include acting as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, which may help alleviate symptoms of coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Black Pine oil include alpha-pinene, beta-pinene, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
